_notes: PROTOTYPE SEED DATA. Except for OpenStreetMap (precomputed per municipality by scripts/osm_coverage.py), every dataset below is a CANDIDATE: existence, extent, endpoint and attribute coverage are assumptions to be verified. Attribute levels: 0 = none, 1 = partial, 2 = full. coverage.municipalities uses Census county-subdivision GEOIDs; coverage.counties uses county names.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap pedestrian features
datasets.notes: Levels are computed per municipality from a statewide OSM extract (scripts/osm_coverage.py); thresholds are in osmLevels() in js/app.js. "Load OSM features" previews live data via Overpass.

datasets.name: PennDOT curb ramp inventory (state routes)
datasets.notes: Candidate. Assumed to cover state-owned routes only (hence partial). Confirm existence, public availability and fields.

datasets.name: DVRPC pedestrian facilities inventory
datasets.notes: Candidate. Regional MPO inventory for SE PA; confirm layers (sidewalks / crosswalks / curb ramps) and vintage.

datasets.name: Philadelphia planimetric sidewalks/curbs
datasets.notes: Candidate. Polygon-style planimetrics typically give geometry (and derivable width) but not routable topology or accessibility attributes.

datasets.name: Pittsburgh City Steps
datasets.notes: Candidate. Public stairways inventory; confirm attributes (condition, length, handrails).

datasets.name: Allegheny County planimetric features
datasets.notes: Candidate. Confirm whether sidewalk edges are included and their vintage.

datasets.name: Project Sidewalk (Pittsburgh deployment)
datasets.notes: Candidate. Crowdsourced accessibility labels from street-level imagery; confirm deployment status and API extent.
